name: JD Intuition
author: Joerg Dommermuth

provenance.from: Ultimate Amiga forum, AMOS Factory downloads section, retrieved 2026-07-26. Most items there are credited "provided and archived by Lonewolf10". Archive path: JD_Extensions.
provenance.note: Documentation coverage was measured by counting how many of the library's own keyword names appear in the files shipped beside it, taking only files that can be documentation (not disk images, example programs or the library itself). That measures the DOCUMENTATION, which is what the `docs` field records; it does not set the evidence tier, which follows from what is available to read.
provenance.redistribution: Third-party extension, redistribution terms unverified unless stated in the notes. Kept as a fixture for identification and reference only.

findings: Joerg Dommermuth's Intuition surface -- open a screen and a window, draw into them with graphics.library, hang boolean gadgets off them and read the IDCMP. Every keyword is a thin wrapper over one library call and every LVO was checked against the FD files shipped in GUI 2.10's Tools/FD rather than recalled. The slot is the binary's twice over: routine 0 ends `moveq #$11,d0` and the data zone is reached through `$208(a5)`, which is `$f8 + 17*16`. Routine 30 is the one to know -- every drawing keyword asks it for a RastPort and it answers with the current window's, else the current screen's, else AMOS's own at `-$18ca(a5)`, so a program that has opened nothing still draws. THE MANUAL IS WRONG TWICE: `Jd Open Intscreen` takes Width, Height, Depth and ViewModes where it promises X, Y, Width and Height, and `Jd Intcolour` takes two arguments and writes a palette entry where it gives one and calls it the drawing colour. Four defects, all read from the binary: `Jd Intscreen Width` and `Jd Intscreen Height` are off by one field each, reading Screen->TopEdge and Screen->Width; `Jd Intfill` dereferences the current window with no null check where every sibling falls back; its TmpRas is declared to InitTmpRas as a flat 40,960 bytes whatever AllocRaster returned; and it is freed by reading two words of the raster's own pixels as the dimensions. Neither memory defect is reproduced. `Jd Intfill` is also Flood in OUTLINE mode with an AOlPen nothing ever sets, so its boundary is always colour 0 whatever the outline was drawn in -- not a defect, but the reason the keyword looks broken. Porting it added three things to src/amiga: custom screens on Intuition, boolean gadgets on a Window, and RastPort.flood.
notes: Opens an Intuition screen and window, draws into it with graphics.library and reads the IDCMP.
